Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about Fearless Logic AI.

Simply describe your business in plain English. Our AI analyzes your idea, generates a strategic blueprint, and builds a complete website with pages, sections, and content — all in seconds. You can then customize everything with drag-and-drop.

Absolutely! On our Pro plan and above, you can connect a custom domain. Starter plan includes a free subdomain (your-site.fearlesslogic.app).

No technical skills required at all. No coding, no design experience, no complicated tools. If you can describe your idea, you can launch a professional website.

Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Upgrading unlocks more features immediately. Downgrading takes effect at your next billing cycle.

You can regenerate any section, edit content directly, swap templates, or start over with a new description. Your project, your control — no lock-in.

Every site built with Fearless Logic AI is fully responsive and looks great on all devices — mobile, tablet, and desktop — right out of the box.

Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. Your published sites will remain live until the end of your billing period.

All plans include email support and our AI help bot. Pro and Scale plans include priority support. Scale plans also include a dedicated account manager.
